question: Can published NeuralNEB PaiNN supply internally consistent conservative energy, force, and full autograd-Hessian evaluations to the shared GAD/Sella interfaces?
hypothesis: Because PaiNN forces are -grad(E), directional energy-force and force-Hessian checks should pass within finite-difference tolerance.
decision_rule: Proceed to the 3-5 structure native-saddle smoke only if all tensor shapes are correct, force directional error is below 2e-4 eV/A, Hessian directional relative error is below 2e-3, and Hessian relative antisymmetry is below 1e-7.

backend.name: neuralneb-painn
backend.hessian: full autograd Hessian of the model energy

resources.allocation: one A100 1g.5gb MIG slice, 4 CPU cores, 12G memory, 15 minutes
resources.purpose: backend validation only; no production throughput inference

next_action: Read the smoke result, record pass/fail and timing, then construct the 3-5 structure PaiNN native-saddle smoke if it passes.
